shortDescription: Britain's government recorded a budget deficit of £18.3 billion  ($24.5 billion) in August, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.A Reuters poll of economists had pointed to a £15.5 billion deficit.($1 = 0.7474 pounds)

children: Britain's government recorded a budget deficit of £18.3 billion  ($24.5 billion) in August, the Office for National Statistics said on Tuesday.
A Reuters poll of economists had pointed to a £15.5 billion deficit.
